controls.name: commit-ends-all-levels
controls.classification: effect: IVG's commit ends every level (4.6.3's SQL COMMIT), committing the caller's work

controls.name: temporal-on-own-connection
controls.classification: routing: create_edge_temporal on the engine's own connection (the USER_GUIDE's description)

controls.name: purge-on-caller-connection
controls.classification: routing: purge_before on the engine's SQL connection

controls.name: undo-ends-all-levels
controls.classification: effect: a failed write's undo rolls back the caller's earlier work (SQL ROLLBACK)

controls.name: refuse-only-after-a-write
controls.classification: decision: refusal decided by the caller's writes instead of $TLEVEL

controls.name: own-process-joins
controls.classification: effect: a call on a second process left uncommitted (as if it joined the caller's transaction)

controls.name: temporal-sql-first
controls.classification: order: InsertEdge's SQL before its global writes (the repair direction)

controls.name: no-implicit-level
controls.classification: provider premise: SQL at $TLEVEL 0 with autocommit off does not open a level
